shape: what looked like a small annoyance turns out to be love

slides.text: dad took my keys off the hall hook every night
he would step outside, start my noisy engine, and turn the car around in the drive
it annoyed me because he always left the seat pushed all the way back
so one evening i asked why he couldn't just leave it where i parked
he just picked up his mug of tea and said the street got busy early
last autumn i finally moved out into my own flat in town
my first morning running late for work, i ran outside in the dark
and realized [[he spent three years]] making sure i never had to reverse into traffic

caption:
he never said drive safe when i left the house
he just kept the windshield clear and the nose pointing forward
send this to the dad who always backed your car out for you.

#dad #dadquotes #fatherdaughter #fatherson
alt: An 8‑slide story about a dad who moved his child's car each night so they never had to reverse in the morning.
